request.text:
NOTICE OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING
Notice is hereby given that the Annual General Meeting of the members of Synthetic Specimen Private Limited will be held on 30 September 2026.
An explanatory statement is annexed. A proxy form is enclosed. E-voting will be available.

response.note: Every finding cites Secretarial Standards and a real ROC adjudication order. A NEEDS_BOOK item is not a defect and not a pass: it is a property of the physical minutes book that no reader of a file can decide.

findings.defect: Serial number of the meeting not stated in the minutes
findings.precedent: Sunima Trading P Ltd, ROC UP-I, 13.07.2026 — Rs 45,000; Merino Shelters, 15.05.2026

findings.defect: Time of commencement of the meeting not recorded
findings.quoted_span: not applicable to a document of type 'notice'
